decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive creature plays combined with burn spells and hand disruption to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The use of efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Amped Raptor, alongside powerful enchantments like Static Prison and Arena of Glory, creates a consistent pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of a Companion in Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional value and options for mana fixing. Overall, this deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on and close out the game swiftly with a mix of direct damage and combat damage.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful black spells and creatures to control the game, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and eventually overpower them with big threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Soul Spike. The deck includes a mix of targeted discard spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, removal spells like Fatal Push, and finishers like Boggart Trawler and The Meathook Massacre. The goal is to grind out the game, deny the opponent resources, and close out the game with powerful spells and creatures.

The main focus of the deck is to quickly deploy aggressive creatures and apply pressure on the opponent. By combining strong creatures like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer with burn spells like Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to deal significant damage in the early game. The inclusion of cards like Galvanic Discharge and Static Prison also helps to control the board and protect your creatures. Additionally, the deck utilizes the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional versatility and consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using cards that generate mana and draw cards, eventually leading to the win condition of Goblin Charbelcher. The deck includes control elements like Force of Negation and Counterspell to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to quickly generate mana with cards like Lotus Bloom and Pentad Prism, while using Tameshi, Reality Architect to tutor for important combo pieces. The deck has no reliance on lands, instead focusing on efficiently utilizing artifact and instant spells to achieve victory.

This deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures and attacking the opponent's life total. It utilizes a mix of multicolored lands to enable Tribal Flames for additional reach, while Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help control the board. The inclusion of companions adds additional value and flexibility to the deck, allowing for different strategic options. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure with efficient creatures and utilize burn spells to close out the game quickly.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride to deal damage quickly. Cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional aggressive options, while Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls help maintain card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison adds disruptive elements to control the board and protect our aggressive creatures. The mana base includes versatile lands like Arid Mesa and Sacred Foundry to ensure smooth mana curve throughout the game.

This combo deck aims to quickly cycle through its deck to find the necessary cards to cast Living End, which will then bring back all creatures from the graveyard to overwhelm the opponent. Subtlety and Generous Ent help dig through the deck, while Waker of Waves and Curator of Mysteries provide alternate win conditions. Endurance and Sink into Stupor disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Force of Negation and Commandeer protect the combo pieces. Overall, this deck focuses on cycling, graveyard manipulation, and powerful creature recursion to achieve victory.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize a combination of powerful control spells and creatures to efficiently manage the board while creating card advantage. The deck focuses on utilizing The One Ring alongside Leyline Binding to control the opponent's actions, while also utilizing Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate value and pressure the opponent. With a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and versatile creatures, this deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through resource management and strategic gameplay.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. The key strategy is to use cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to deal damage quickly, while also utilizing cards like Static Prison and Goblin Bombardment for control and removal. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds flexibility to the deck's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and close out games swiftly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of the deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. By utilizing cards like Counterspell, Fatal Push, and Thought Scour, the deck aims to keep the opponent's threats in check while building its own board presence with creatures like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus. Additionally, the deck includes graveyard recursion with Unearth and card draw with Consider to maintain card advantage and stay ahead in the game. The mana base is designed to support the deck's strategy with efficient color fixing and land options.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with a mix of creature and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for additional mana ramp. The key is to efficiently use cards like Tribal Flames, Lightning Bolt, and Ragavan to control the board while building towards a powerful finisher like Scion of Draco or Phlage. Leyline cards provide support while Orcish Bowmasters and Stubborn Denial offer protection. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's strategy.

The deck aims to use a combination of creatures with high mana costs and cards like Living End to quickly cycle through the deck and bring out powerful creatures from the graveyard. By using cards like Misty Rainforest and Shardless Agent to manipulate the top of the deck, the player can control when and how Living End is cast to maximize its impact. The deck also includes cards like Force of Negation and Endurance to protect against disruption from the opponent and ensure the combo can go off successfully.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of cycling creatures and spells to rapidly fill up the graveyard, eventually casting Living End to return all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield. This allows the deck to quickly rebuild its board state and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. The deck also includes control elements such as Force of Negation and Subtlety to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own strategy. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Generous Ent and Endurance to maintain hand advantage and further disrupt the opponent's plans.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It supplements this strategy with cards like Lightning Bolt and Goblin Bombardment for direct damage, and Static Prison to control the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Jegantha, the Wellspring allows for additional versatility and disruption against opponent strategies. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah serves as a powerful finisher while also providing support to the deck's aggressive approach. Overall, the deck aims to quickly establish board presence and pressure the opponent for a swift victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on explosive early game aggression with cards like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls to overwhelm the opponent quickly. Utilizing cards like Static Prison and Skyclave Apparition to control the board while burning the opponent down with direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to seal the deal. With access to mana fixing lands and strong support cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, this deck aims to build a strong board presence and close out the game before the opponent can mount a defense.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using various mana ramp cards and lands, allowing you to play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker ahead of schedule. It also includes control elements like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt your opponent's strategy. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with giant creatures while controlling the board and maintaining a strong mana base.
